title: What is CSS Grid
question: What is CSS Grid and how is it different from Flexbox?
realWorldScenario: Grid is used for the overall page skeleton (header/sidebar/main/footer) while Flexbox handles the items inside each area.

title: grid-template-columns
question: How does `grid-template-columns` work? Give an example of defining a three-column grid.
searchIntent: how to use grid-template-columns in css
realWorldScenario: `grid-template-columns: 250px 1fr 1fr` creates a fixed sidebar and two equal content columns.

title: fr unit in CSS Grid
question: What does the `fr` unit mean in CSS Grid and how is it different from `%` or `px`?
searchIntent: what is fr unit in css grid
realWorldScenario: `1fr 2fr` distributes remaining space in a 1:2 ratio; `%` includes gap in the math which causes overflow.

title: gap / grid-gap property
question: What does the `gap` property do in CSS Grid and what are its older equivalents?
searchIntent: how to add spacing between grid items
realWorldScenario: `gap: 16px` adds consistent gutters between all grid cells without margin hacks.

title: grid-column and grid-row span
question: How do you make a grid item span multiple columns or rows?
seoKeywords: grid item span multiple columns css
searchIntent: how to span grid item across columns
css grid span multiple columns rows
realWorldScenario: A featured article card in a news grid spans 2 columns with `grid-column: span 2`.

title: auto-fill vs auto-fit
question: What is the difference between `auto-fill` and `auto-fit` when used with `repeat()` in CSS Grid?
searchIntent: what is difference between auto-fill and auto-fit
realWorldScenario: `auto-fit` collapses empty columns so items stretch to fill the row; `auto-fill` keeps the empty column slots.

title: grid-template-areas
question: What is `grid-template-areas` and how does it make layout code more readable?
searchIntent: how to use grid-template-areas in css
realWorldScenario: Defining a page layout with named areas (header, sidebar, main, footer) so placement reads like a visual map.

title: minmax() function
question: What does the `minmax()` function do in CSS Grid?
searchIntent: what is minmax in css grid
realWorldScenario: `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))` creates a responsive card grid that never goes below 200px per card.

title: Implicit vs explicit grid
question: What is the difference between the explicit grid and the implicit grid in CSS Grid?
realWorldScenario: Content added dynamically creates implicit rows — use `grid-auto-rows` to control their height.
